'''Dan Sokol''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd, 12 (+51), 6–2 at [[1999 Battle of Midway]] on 7 August 1999 with Revolver, according to Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d5">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ binghamton-new-york-8-7-99], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 12 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
